highlight: On-call tapers into a warm spring week of homemade pasta, pizza, and a Friday branzino — capped by a Laura-less Saturday dad-daughter taco party.
family_message: The house-offer conversation keeps circling back to a deeper question: what actually makes a place worth wanting? This week leans into that. Sunday's slow gravy and Tuesday's hand-rolled Babo pasta are built from time, not money. Thursday pulls Elsie into Dad's work world for a morning. Friday's branzino is a small Mediterranean splurge before Laura flies to Grand Rapids on Saturday morning. Value, it turns out, lives in the doing.
school_note: Elsie is home Tuesday — election day, no school.
on_call_note: Dan is on-call through Tuesday midday — expect possible interruptions Sun–Tue morning.
travel_note: Laura leaves for Grand Rapids Saturday morning — dad and Elsie run the show Saturday and Sunday.
house_note: The house-offer conversation is still live. Theme of the week: what is actually worth paying for?

days.name: Sun 04/19
days.dinner: Homemade Extruded Pasta with Sunday Gravy
days.dinner_description: All-day tomato gravy with pork ribs, sausage, and meatballs simmered into fresh spinach pasta extruded on the pasta machine. The slowest possible answer to a drizzly on-call Sunday.
days.dinner_notes: Start the gravy by 11 AM. Extrude pasta around 4:30.
days.album_description: Michael Kiwanuka's self-titled third album, produced by Danger Mouse and Inflo, is a widescreen soul record about owning your name and your history. A British son of Ugandan refugees answers a critic who told him his name was unmarketable by putting it on the cover in all caps.
days.album_sonic_description: Lush strings, fuzzy guitars, and gospel backing vocals layered over Danger Mouse's cinematic production — mid-tempo soul with a slow, steady heartbeat.
days.album_pairing_rationale: A slow Sunday gravy simmering for hours needs a record with the same patient warmth, and the album's theme of grounding yourself in who and where you come from maps perfectly onto a cold, drizzly house-hunting week about valuing home.
days.weather_detail: Cloudy — 37% sunshine, 75% precip, 22 mph wind (gusts to 43 mph)

days.name: Mon 04/20
days.dinner: Steak & Romaine Salad with Cucumbers, Red Onions, and Avocados
days.dinner_description: Reverse-seared ribeye or NY strip sliced over crunchy hearts of romaine, cool cucumber, sharp red onion, and creamy avocado. A fast, protein-heavy plate to kick off the work week.
days.dinner_notes: Pull steak from fridge 45 minutes before cooking to temper. Regular dinner time — plate around 6:30.
days.album_description: Austin duo Eric Burton and producer Adrian Quesada fuse 60s psychedelic soul with modern grit. Burton was busking on the Santa Monica pier when Quesada found him, and the debut is the sound of a singer finally getting the room he deserves.
days.album_sonic_description: Gritty fuzz guitar, tight horn stabs, tambourine grooves, and a voice that sits between Marvin Gaye and Leon Bridges.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Monday's clean, protein-forward plate wants something smoky and soulful but not demanding — the Pumas' warm, mid-tempo grooves sit just right beside a seared steak and crisp romaine.
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny — 85% sunshine, 7% precip, 16 mph wind (gusts to 30 mph)

days.name: Tue 04/21
days.dinner_description: The family-favorite silky spinach pasta made with egg yolks only — no whites. Rich, tender, and the dish Elsie requests by name. Toss with a quick brown butter and Parmigiano.
days.dinner_notes: Elsie is home (no school) — great day to pull her into kneading and cranking the pasta machine.
days.album_description: Recorded live at the Gold-Diggers hotel/bar/studio in Los Angeles, Bridges leaves his retro-gospel lane to write about who he is now — a Texan in his thirties reckoning with love, faith, and the pull between home and away.
days.album_sonic_description: Plucked bass, brushed drums, plush strings, and Bridges' honey tenor floating over chord changes that owe equal debts to Sam Cooke and D'Angelo.
days.album_pairing_rationale: A sunny 61°F no-school day with a 6pm swim needs a gentle groove that keeps the kitchen moving while the silky, yolky Babo pasta cooks — Bridges' plush Texas R&B matches the creamy simplicity on the plate.
days.weather_detail: Sunny — 98% sunshine, 2% precip, 11 mph wind (gusts to 32 mph)
calendar_items: NO SCHOOL (Election Day) — Elsie home all day
Swim Lessons 6:00-6:30 PM (Level 4, Colts Neck Rd)

days.name: Wed 04/22
days.dinner: Pan-Fried Pork Dumplings + Garlic Sesame Noodles with Bok Choy
days.dinner_description: Crisp-bottomed frozen pork dumplings alongside a quick scratch-made garlic-sesame noodle bowl tossed with baby bok choy. Clears freezer, leans on pantry — ready in 25 minutes.
dinner_key_ingredients: thin wheat noodles or lo mein
days.dinner_notes: Restock freezer dumplings this week — we're running low.
days.album_description: London's Ibibio Sound Machine — led by British-Nigerian singer Eno Williams — teamed up with Hot Chip for a sweaty, high-voltage record. Williams sings in English and Ibibio, weaving her grandmother's folktales into modern dance music.
days.album_sonic_description: Analog synths, Afrobeat guitar, call-and-response vocals, and a rhythm section that never lets up — 1970s Lagos filtered through a London warehouse party.
days.album_pairing_rationale: A drizzly Wednesday with crispy dumplings and sesame-garlic noodles calls for percussive, bold music that matches the snap of the pan-fry — and the album's joy-as-resistance theme is exactly the lift a mid-week house-hunt stretch needs.
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny — 62% sunshine, 23% precip, 11 mph wind (gusts to 34 mph)

days.name: Thu 04/23
days.dinner_description: Family pizza night — overnight cold-fermented dough, San Marzano sauce, fresh mozzarella, whatever toppings everyone votes for. Pies go in a screaming-hot oven (or Ooni if dry).
days.dinner_notes: Let Elsie shape her own pie after Bring-Your-Family-to-Work Day.
days.album_description: The Sheffield band's sleek, hip-hop-informed breakthrough. Alex Turner moved to LA and wrote a whole album of 3am voicemails he never sent — every song a phone call you shouldn't make, funny, sad, and desperately hummable.
days.album_sonic_description: Fuzz-bass riffs, handclaps, Josh Homme falsetto backing vocals, and drums that swing harder than rock drums usually do.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Pizza night after a Bring-Family-to-Work day wants a rock record the whole family can loudly sing along to, and the Pixies-adjacent swagger of AM — nostalgic for the liked-band list without repeating it — delivers dough-flinging energy on a sunny 73°F evening.
days.weather_detail: Sunny — 97% sunshine, 6% precip, 8 mph wind (gusts to 11 mph)
calendar_items: Bring Your Family to Work Day 10 AM-12 PM (Elsie + Dan @ Reston MS office)

days.name: Fri 04/24
days.dinner: Whole Roasted Branzino with Sautéed Kale and Creamy Polenta
days.dinner_description: Whole branzino stuffed with lemon and herbs, roasted on a sheet pan until the skin shatters. Served over soft Parmesan polenta with garlicky lacinato kale — a small-splurge Mediterranean plate for the warmest night of the week.
days.dinner_notes: Ask the fishmonger to scale and gut the fish. Start polenta 30 min before fish goes in.
days.album_description: London saxophonist Nubya Garcia's debut traces her Guyanese-Trinidadian roots through dub, cumbia, and jazz. She grew up in London but kept reaching back to understand where her sound came from — the record is that reaching made audible.
days.album_sonic_description: Breathy tenor saxophone, dub basslines, cumbia shakers, and patient grooves that build without ever rushing.
days.album_pairing_rationale: A Mediterranean branzino dinner on a 79°F Friday calls for breezy but rhythmic music with movement — Garcia's sun-soaked, Caribbean-inflected jazz has the oceanic feel of a whole fish on the plate and the propulsion to keep the evening alive.

days.name: Sat 04/25
days.dinner_description: A dad-and-daughter taco bar — seasoned ground beef and grilled chicken, warm corn and flour tortillas, and a spread of fixings Elsie gets to arrange herself. Her night to build the plate.
days.dinner_notes: Laura left this morning for Grand Rapids. Make it fun — let Elsie set up the taco bar on the counter.
days.album_description: Colombian electro-cumbia ringleaders Bomba Estéreo's third record. Singer Li Saumet grew up on Colombia's Caribbean coast where cumbia meets champeta meets soundsystem culture, and the album is her love letter to that world — sophisticated and sweaty at once.
days.album_sonic_description: Accordion samples, 808 kicks, gaita flutes, and chanted hooks — cumbia DNA wired to a dance-music spine.
days.album_pairing_rationale: A dad-and-8-year-old taco night with Laura on the road wants a full-on kitchen dance party, and Bomba Estéreo's rapid-fire Spanish hooks turn taco assembly into a two-person rave — the perfect high-energy send-off to the week.

appetizers.name: Whipped Ricotta with Spring Peas & Mint on Crostini
appetizers.description: Creamy whipped ricotta on grilled baguette topped with smashed spring peas, mint, lemon zest, and flaky salt.

appetizers.name: Charred Scallion & Soy Dipping Sauce with Crispy Wontons
appetizers.description: Crisp-fried wonton wrappers with a smoky charred-scallion, soy, sesame, and chili-crisp dip — perfect Wednesday starter or pizza-night add-on.

salads.name: Shaved Fennel, Radish & Orange Composed Salad
salads.description: Thinly shaved fennel and watermelon radish fanned around blood orange segments, toasted pistachios, and shaved ricotta salata on a bed of little gem.
salads.dressing: Orange-Dijon vinaigrette: fresh orange juice, champagne vinegar, Dijon, shallot, extra-virgin olive oil, flaky salt

salads.name: Charred Romaine Caesar with Anchovy Breadcrumbs
salads.description: Romaine hearts charred over the burner, tossed with a punchy caesar and topped with crispy anchovy-garlic breadcrumbs.
salads.dressing: Classic caesar: egg yolk, anchovy, garlic, Dijon, lemon, Worcestershire, parmesan, black pepper, extra-virgin olive oil

salads.name: Cucumber, Mint & Feta Side Salad
salads.description: Smashed Persian cucumbers with crumbled feta, red onion, mint, dill, and kalamata olives.
salads.dressing: Lemon-oregano: fresh lemon juice, dried oregano, extra-virgin olive oil, black pepper

salads.name: Asian Slaw with Toasted Sesame
salads.description: Shredded napa cabbage, carrots, scallions, and cilantro with toasted sesame seeds and crushed peanuts.
salads.dressing: Ginger-soy-sesame: rice vinegar, soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, grated ginger, honey, lime

beverages.name: Lemon-Basil Sparkling Water
beverages.description: Fresh lemon and torn basil muddled into sparkling water — crisp and family-friendly.
beverages.pairing_note: Bright match for Italian dinners (Sun, Tue) and pizza night.

beverages.name: Ginger-Lime Kombucha Spritz
beverages.description: Ginger-lime kombucha over ice with extra lime wedges — gut-friendly and gently sparkling.
beverages.pairing_note: Cuts through Wednesday's dumplings and Saturday's tacos.

beverages.name: Chianti Classico (Dan & Laura)
beverages.description: A bright, cherry-forward Chianti Classico for the Italian dinners.
beverages.pairing_note: Sunday gravy, Tuesday Babo, Thursday pizza — all three sing with it.

Produce: baby spinach (2 lbs — for Babo pasta + Sunday gravy wilted greens)
Protein: pork spare ribs (2-3 lbs) — Sun gravy
Italian sausage, sweet (1 lb) — Sun gravy
ground beef 80/20 (2 lbs) — Sun meatballs + Sat tacos
ribeye or NY strip (2, ~12 oz each) — Mon
Pantry & Grains: thin wheat noodles or lo mein (2 packs)
soy sauce, black vinegar, toasted sesame oil

prep_ahead: Saturday (today): pull pork ribs & sausage from freezer to thaw for Sunday gravy.
Saturday: make pizza dough for Thursday (cold ferment 72 hrs in fridge).
Sunday evening: make meatballs & portion extra gravy; freeze half for next month.
Monday morning: temper steak 2 hours before 8 PM dinner.
Tuesday morning: make Babo pasta dough with Elsie (she's home); rest in fridge until 5 PM.
Wednesday: grocery run for dumpling restock + fish order for Friday branzino.
Thursday morning: pull pizza dough from fridge 2 hours before dinner to come to room temp.
Friday: pick up branzino from fishmonger, ask them to scale + gut.
Saturday: set up taco bar on the kitchen counter with Elsie as head bartender.
notes: Sunday gravy yields enough for a freezer stash — portion 2 quart bags after dinner.
Babo pasta uses 12-16 egg yolks; save whites for Saturday frittata lunch or meringues.
Wednesday: we're running low on frozen dumplings — restock this week.
Pizza night after Bring-Family-to-Work lets Elsie decompress with a tactile activity — shaping dough is the reward.
Saturday with Laura gone: keep it simple and fun. Taco bar beats takeout every time.
